description: A full-stack multi-tenant SaaS application implementing tenant-level data isolation, role-based access control, and Dockerized deployment.
problem_statement: Design and implement a scalable SaaS platform that supports multiple tenants using a shared database while ensuring strict data isolation, secure authentication, and role-based authorization.

architecture.multi_tenancy_model: Shared database with shared schema using tenant_id-based isolation
architecture.authentication: JWT-based authentication with role-based access control

features: Separate login flow for tenant users and super admins
Project and task management scoped to tenants
notes: The project is fully implemented with backend, frontend, Docker configuration, and documentation. All APIs were tested and validated against the requirements.
